Detailed Description

A daemon's complete configuration, grouped by the pipeline responsibility each field belongs to.

A shipped entrypoint reads whichever groups its own work touches, not only the group named after it:

  • The distributed selector reads [common] and [selector].
  • The distributed worker reads [common], [selector].backendStatusQueue, [compiler], and [submitter].
  • The standalone daemon reads [common], [selector].selectionPolicy, and [submitter].
